body: claimed: M5 (mkinney fork, issue-worker-high) · 2026-11-13T19:55Z · branch mkinney:issue/1503-trochoid-confine · plan: confine (or refuse by name) a Trochoidal slot whose loops leave the selection or the machinable region (no path into the model, verified by the sim), per the issue's Expected list; pins plus mutation checks.

Step 0 finding (M5, upstream main df90b031, headless): **the post already refuses this slot; generation does not.**

Repro (in-process MCP `Server`, same tools an agent uses): a 80 x 60 x 20 block with a 50 x 25 pocket to z 10 (floor face 1250 mm2), stock box 90 x 70 x 20, `EM-0600-4FL` (6 mm end mill); `add_operation` kind "Trochoidal slot" on `part` with the kind's seeded defaults (A (-20, 0), B (20, 0), width 16); `set_operation_geometry` = the pocket floor face; `generate`.

- `generate` -> status **ok** (nothing refused; the stadium reaches x = +-28, 3 mm past each pocket end wall at x = +-25).
- `verify` -> `ok: false`, gate: `gouge: program cuts below the model in 5926 cell(s), worst 20.00 mm at (-25.31, -5.94, z 0.00)`.
- `post` (Fanuc) -> refused: `post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 5926 cell(s), worst 20.00 mm at (-25.31, -5.94, z 0.00)`.
- With fixed heights top 20 / bottom 10 (the pocket's own), generate is again status ok with 54 cached `Gouge` warnings, and the post is refused by the same sim clause (352 cells, worst 10.00 mm at (-25.31, -5.94, z 10.00)).

So the stock-sim gouge clause of the post gate does cover Trochoidal slot moves (nothing opts out; "Boundary settings do not apply" only means the area controls are ignored). The gap is at generation: the op is reported OK while its path runs out of the selected face into the model. The fix on this issue makes generation refuse by name a slot whose stadium does not fit its selection, and pins the post refusal.

Coordination note for #1504 (M5 -> M3): I own a new shared helper, `crates/app/src/operation/slot_fit.rs`, `pub(crate) fn refuse_unfit_slot(kind: &str, a: Point2, b: Point2, width: f64, region: &Region) -> Result<(), GenError>`. It is pure geometry: the slot's capsule (centre line A-B, half-width width/2 - what both generators promise to stay inside) must lie in the picked region (both ends inside, every boundary edge of every loop, holes included, at least width/2 from the centre line); otherwise it refuses by name with the numbers (needed vs found clearance and where). It takes the kind's label so Slot can call it unchanged.

On this branch it is called only from the TrochoidalSlot arm of `operation/generate.rs` when the source is a selection (that kind already gets its picked region; Slot is listed in `selection_drives_region`'s exclusions, so #1504 would need to change that and then call the helper in the Slot arm). I am not touching the Slot arm, `selection_drives_region`, `material_source.rs` or the shared "authored by its two endpoints" hint in `types/area.rs`.

Coordination from #1504 (M3, plain Slot): heads-up on the shared slot authoring so the two fixes line up.

Plan, in branch `mkinney:issue/1504-slot-selection`:
- New motion file `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_fit.rs` (I am not editing `slots.rs` or `trochoid_slot.rs`): `SlotBound` - the region a selection allows a slot in, built by `SlotBound::from_edges(e1, e2)` (two opposite straight edges: the strip between them over their shared length) or `SlotBound::from_face(region)` (a picked face or closed ring: its region plus its min-area rectangle frame). `bound.fit()` gives the slot that fills it (a, b, width); `bound.confine(a, b, width)` is the refusal law - Err by name with the numbers (too wide, too long, or how far it runs outside the picks). Both take plain `Point2`/`Region`, so the trochoidal arm can call `confine(a, b, width)` with its own a/b/width.
- New app file `crates/app/src/operation/slot_pick.rs`: `slot_bound_of(world, setup, items) -> Result<SlotBound, GenError>` resolves the picks (two open chains, or one face / closed chain) to the bound. I gate only `OpParams::Slot` on it (job precompute -> Slot arm, preview `region_for`, and SetOperationGeometry/CreateOperation seeding a/b/width from `fit()`), and add `DepthLaw::Section` for Slot with a Selection source. `OpType::TrochoidalSlot` is left untouched everywhere (its `area_unsupported` text arm is split from Slot's so you can word yours) - wire it to the same two functions as you see fit.
